sentences.text: The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 24- 05-2021.
After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with the accused.
When CW-1 was staying with the accused, the accused No.1 started to harass CW-1 mentally and physically in respect of dowry by demanding her to get Rs.50,00,000/- from her parents.

On 18-02-2022 the accused assaulted her with his hands over her face, twisted her left hand, kicked her with his left leg on her stomach, abused her in filthy language and accused also gave life threat to her and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty in demand of additional dowry.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.95/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Harshini.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 24-05-2021 and deposed after the  5  C.C.No.16904/2022 marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted her and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the Harshini Prakash vs Karthik H B on 4 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104883104/

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A,323,504, 506 of IPC. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
